decisions.decision: D-21: the certified-WORKS RE-PLAN. CERTIFY-WORKS-BOARD-DECISION.md (3-round UNANIMOUS cross-family board: 2 Opus + gpt-5.5 + gemini-3.1-pro-preview) is THE AUTHORITY, superseding the D-02 false-uphold positives source. TWO arms, split-source: arm B (over-refusal) STAYS live-harvested (N>=30, CP<=TAU_OR 0.15); arm A (false-uphold) is NOW manually-constructed contrastive minimal-pairs, each a minimal edit of a REAL live dense bundle (N>=30, CP<=TAU_FU 0.10). WORKS iff pre-registered + minimal-edit + the construct-validity gate (minimal-edit mandatory + lexical-AUC <= 0.60-0.65 + one-sided not-easier SMD>0.5 + optional blind audit); else SCOPED. 10-pair pre-scale probe gates on gold-panel unanimity >=9/10 + lexical AUC (scored voter run-but-not-gated). STRONG (Sonnet) certified FIRST; CHEAP (Haiku) a SEPARATE cert (EVAL-05 prompt + task-fit pre-gate).
decisions.rationale: the harvest-from-own-output false-uphold source is empirically infeasible (~0.33 dense-SUPPORTED/run); the board replaced it with manual contrastive construction + a construct-validity gate
